queues.shared_review_reason: byte-identical FILES exist in more than one location
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: Choose which copy is canonical. Originals are never deleted by the system; nothing is consolidated automatically.

queues.shared_review_reason: candidates segmented from ONE source surface
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: Review the sheet together, then confirm/split/merge/relabel/exclude each candidate. NOTE: these are independent assets reviewed together — they are NOT duplicates and NOT substitutes for one another.

queues.shared_review_reason: one artwork carried in several FORMATS
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: Confirm the source relationship. Each member keeps its OWN technical readiness, capabilities and rights — no member inherits another's.

queues.shared_review_reason: UNKNOWN_RELATIONSHIP — CANDIDATE_VS_WHOLE_SHEET_MISMATCH. A comparison WAS generated; the available evidence was insufficient. This is a review queue, NOT positive family evidence.
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: A whole-file candidate is being compared with a crop from a segmented sheet — the units are not comparable. Decide whether the SOURCES are related instead.

queues.shared_review_reason: UNKNOWN_RELATIONSHIP — CONFLICTING_HASH_EVIDENCE. A comparison WAS generated; the available evidence was insufficient. This is a review queue, NOT positive family evidence.
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: dHash and pHash disagree. Look at the pair and decide.

queues.shared_review_reason: UNKNOWN_RELATIONSHIP — EPS_VISUAL_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. A comparison WAS generated; the available evidence was insufficient. This is a review queue, NOT positive family evidence.
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: Do NOT read these as visually unrelated. Confirm the source/package relationship, and defer any visual judgement until Ghostscript lands.
Select (or reject) the canonical asset. The machine only nominates; rights evidence contributed ZERO to the nomination score.

queues.shared_review_reason: VISUAL_COMPARISON_UNAVAILABLE: no perceptual hash could be computed
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: Do NOT read these as visually unrelated — the comparison could not be made. Source/package relationships still apply. Visual judgement waits for Ghostscript.

queues.shared_review_reason: the image carries too little visual information for a hash to be trusted
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: Judge by eye, or exclude from the reusable library.

queues.shared_review_reason: a low-confidence edge was the SOLE connector between two halves of a component; the component was split there
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: Confirm whether the two halves are really one family, or correctly split.

queues.shared_review_reason: technically strong, but ownership is unconfirmed and licence unverified
queues.recommended_reviewer_action: Confirm ownership/licence. Until then the asset is UNUSABLE regardless of how technically clean it is.

blocking_coverage_limitation.coverage_note: complete for this pilot (no bucket exceeded the limit)
blocking_coverage_limitation.reason_for_the_limit: an unbounded bucket explodes into O(n^2) pairs; the limit keeps candidate generation tractable without returning to naive all-pairs comparison

note: machine and human sections are separate; every human field is blank; no batch decision is applied automatically
